children: Greenland Mines entered agreements to strengthen its balance sheet, including a registered direct offering expected to yield approximately $38.4 million in net proceeds and an amendment lowering the exercise price on its private warrants. The offering comprises 1,765,420 common shares and pre-funded warrants for up to 1,434,580 shares at $12.00 per share or warrant, with pre-funded warrants exercisable at $0.0001 and subject to a 4.99% (or 9.99% at holder election) ownership cap. Separately, the company cut the exercise price on its previously issued private warrants to $5.00 per share. Proceeds will support Greenland mining operations, general corporate purposes, and working capital.
